# Quantum Computing Breakthrough 2026

## Executive Summary
In March 2026, Helios Labs announced the deployment of the Aurora-7 quantum processor.
The system features 256 logical qubits with a fault-tolerant error threshold of 99.98%.
The cooling apparatus operates at 15 millikelvin using a closed-loop helium-3 dilution refrigerator.

## Financial Impact
Helios Labs invested $420 million over four years into the project.
Commercial availability began on April 1, 2026, with an initial enterprise subscription tier of $75,000 per month.
Operating margins for the quantum cloud platform are projected to reach 34% by Q4 2026.
